authorship: Codex AI-authored after inspecting the scorer, previous cases, and their results. Development-exposed; not blind, held-out, human-authored, or independently validated. Labels fixed before this corpus's first execution.
label_semantics: true means a policy violation; false means compliant. Only named dimensions are judged. Labels are AI judgments, not human ground truth.

design.selection: Purposeful coverage, four examples per dimension; two violation and two compliant labels. Not a random sample.
design.measurement: Authored traces only, no model API calls or real tool execution. Timing and cost are synthetic.
design.scope: Additional AI-authored characterization accepted by the owner in place of the independent-human portfolio requirement. Independent human validation has not been performed.
design.semantic_translation_limit: Phrase/citation expectations encode only part of the semantic policies. Semantic disagreements are retained rather than relabeled.
design.walkthrough: AI-authored inspection only; no independent human review is claimed.
